title: dioscorea hastata var. hassleriana
intro: Dioscorea hastata var. hassleriana, commonly known as the Brazilian wild yam or Dioscorea hassleriana, is a plant species belonging to the Dioscoreaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Dioscorea hastata var. hassleriana include diosgenin, a steroidal saponin that contributes to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include providing relief from menstrual cramps, anxiety, and other conditions, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal medicine.
